name: CYVXAI-OS Governed Topology Consolidation
stop_conditions: Stop when the working tree is dirty or the generated plan digest no longer matches.
Stop when a destination exists, a protected root is selected, or an alias cannot be created.
Stop and automatically roll back when any verification command fails.
Require explicit digest approval for medium-risk and high-risk stages.
Do not deploy, purchase, change credentials, or remove compatibility aliases automatically.

stages.title: Consolidate research leaves
stages.description: Move isolated research and theory domains beneath research/ while retaining old paths as compatibility aliases.

stages.title: Consolidate domain assets
stages.description: Move business identity and legal domain assets beneath domains/ after research leaves are stable.

stages.title: Unify operations planes
stages.description: Consolidate infrastructure, operations, observability, security, evidence, and retained artifacts beneath ops/.

stages.title: Consolidate product and control surfaces
stages.description: Move optional product surfaces beneath apps/ and the legacy control plane beneath platform/.

stages.title: Consolidate intelligence and economic modules
stages.description: Move optional intelligence, internet, evaluation, and economics domains beneath services/ after all earlier stages prove stable.
